facts.business: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited is a global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Hyderabad, India, that accelerates access to affordable and innovative medicines, with a portfolio including APIs, generic formulations, biosimilars, OTC products, innovative products, and custom pharmaceutical services, focusing on key therapeutic areas like Oncology, Central Nervous System, Pain Management, and Gastro-Intestinal.
facts.related_party_note: Purchases with related parties were 0.55% of total purchases in FY2026 (0.71% in FY2025). Sales to related parties were 0.002% of total sales in both FY2026 and FY2025. Loans & advances and investments in related parties were Nil in both years. 100% of inputs are sourced from suppliers who abide by the Third Party Code of Conduct.
